title: Symmetry and Monotonicity of Equal-Weight Thresholds
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube. If there is a real number $a$ such that $f(x)$ is the sign of $a+\sum_i x_i$ for every input $x$, with zero assigned the positive sign, then $f$ is invariant under every permutation of its coordinates and is monotone in the coordinatewise order.
